title: Life-Changing Benefits Of Fasting: Spiritual Awakening Guide
paragraphs: But I will talk about fasting first because I want to make sure you are safe. Note that I put the word "strength" next to the word "fasting". Because prayer has power, but fasting has its own level of power. Fasting is like adding a new, high-powered combustion engine to your old one. Fasting is about taking your ordinary life to a level you have never reached before. It's like adding another cylinder to your car. Therefore, fasting provides extraordinary strength. And I know what I'm talking about personally.

I call fasting the key to the kingdom of power in prayer. You can pray and still not get results. But it is impossible to pray and fast and not get results. There are times when our prayers have no effect. But it is always guaranteed that when you add fasting to your prayers, it has an effect. Most of us were not encouraged to fast. We were not taught how to fast. I want to start with some general statements. All religions pray. So, prayer is a common thing.

Buddhists pray, Hindus pray, Muslims pray, followers of world religions pray, even the Church of Satan prays. So prayer is not a unique thing. Prayer is not exclusive to the church or religious people who are called Christians. In many cases, many religions pray more than Christians. Whether they get answers is another question, but they are arriving more often. I'm sure you are aware that religions like Hinduism involve long hours of prayer.

Buddhists meditate for hours and practice meditation for hours, trying to unite with the universe. Through this meditative prayer, they can sit with their legs crossed to pray and meditate for days. Muslims pray at least three times a day wherever they are. They spread their prayer rug on the ground and head east towards Mecca and pray. Most Christians don't pray that much. So prayer is not the issue. Everyone does that. Of course, questions come to your mind. Who are you praying to? What are you praying for?

And whether your prayer will be heard, or whether it is heard at all. These are questions being raised abroad. Jesus himself said to the Pharisees, “You pray and think that you will be heard because of your many words.” He was speaking to these converts to Judaism, the leaders of Judaism who were praying to Yahweh, the God you serve. But he says that you think you will be heard because you are praying these long prayers.

In other words, you can even be a believer in Jehovah and still not get an answer to your prayers. So it is not just Muslims, Buddhists, Hindus, followers of Confucius, and others. Even saints who are called Christians may pray and not receive any answers, because he said that the abundance of your words does not guarantee that your prayers will be answered. And once again, we learn in this dedication that prayer has little to do with the length of your prayer. High- sounding words do not impress God.

So prayer is a common thing. Second point, prayer is not an option for us. It is a necessity. God did not leave prayer to a decision you make. Rather, he made it a will. Prayer is a commandment. You must pray. God says that when you do not pray, you are disobedient. So you are about to enter into an experience that will make God very pleased with you. When you please God, then He will fulfill what He has promised. Therefore, prayer is a commandment. It's the law. It's an order. This leads me to point three.

Prayer is the most common experience for a believer. What I mean by that is that every time someone surrenders their life to the Lord, they are told that they must pray. Therefore, every believer is encouraged to pray. It is the most common thing that you are expected to do. But here lies the problem. Prayer is the most frequently discussed topic in conversation, but it is the least practiced. We prefer singing in the choir to praying. We prefer to be organized at the door rather than spend time praying.

We prefer playing the piano in church to praying. We prefer working in the hospitality department or working in the nursery to spending time praying. In other words, we want any other activity except please don't ask us to pray. We place prayer as something we do occasionally when someone makes us feel guilty towards them. But I hope you will discover that prayer is no longer an option and that you will see it as the most important thing you do. Why don't people pray? Here is my answer. Because of the results.

They are not getting results. I grew up in a religious environment, just like you. I've always wondered about this. Why do we see on Sunday mornings, for those who worship on Sundays, that the church building is packed with people? If you are a Seventh-day Adventist, on Saturday morning the church building is full of people. If you are a Muslim, you will find that at prayer times, everyone is in the mosque. But there is a problem. I noticed that on the night of the prayer meeting, everyone disappears.

The only people who attend the prayer meeting are some old women who have nothing else to do. We call them intercessors. What we really mean by that is those who pray because we do not pray. This is what intercessor means to you. Those who pray because we don't have time to do so. The prayer meeting is always the smallest meeting in every church. check it out. I mean, having this many people at a prayer meeting here represents a whole church to some.

I have been to and been in churches all my life where they have lots of people on Sunday mornings, and the prayer meeting is attended by only 10 people. The question is why? The answer is because people are not getting results. I think I'm just like you. If you keep doing something and it's not successful, you stop doing it. That makes sense, doesn't it? It's like going to a soda machine, putting in your money, pressing the button, and nothing comes out.

You put in more money, press the button, and nothing comes out. Now, after four or five dollars, we hope that by then you will realize that it is better to stay away from this machine. Because this is how prayer is for most people. They prayed, and then went to the prayer meeting. Sometimes, when you are a young Christian, you can't wait to go to a prayer meeting. You are excited. Then you finally realize why others don't come, because you don't get answers to pray. These old people pray and nothing works.

You are not getting any responses. You see no evidence. There is no response of any kind from God. So you start by saying that this is not working. And so it stops. That's why people don't pray, because they don't get answers. But here's what I call the principle of prayer. When you carefully study God's word and God's work in history, you will come to the same conclusion that John Wesley reached years ago. I thought he did a great job expressing it. I understood it myself. But John Wesley said this.

He said: "It seems that without God, man cannot do anything on earth, but without man, God will not do anything on earth." Beautiful phrase. Without God, man cannot, and without man, God will not. There are things God wants to accomplish on Earth for the sake of His kingdom. He wants his kingdom to come on earth, but he cannot do it without man, and man cannot do it without God. In other words, prayer is actually a partnership between the divine and humanity. God needs you and you need God.

The point is that what happens on Earth does not really depend on God. It depends on you. When I learned this, I started praying on two feet every minute. I pray all the time. I don't go to prayer meetings. I am a prayer meeting in and of myself. Anyone who spends time with me will hear me praying all the time. Let someone just say: "Jesus is Lord." I pray, saying, "Jesus is Lord." I invoke His authority in my environment all the time. Why?

Because God cannot do anything on Earth without a human being giving him permission to do so. Let me quote a written text that proves this. Jesus said, “Wherever two of you on earth agree and decide anything, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.” A simple phrase, with profound implications. It tells us that Heaven wants to do many things on Earth, but Heaven is waiting for at least two people to unite and agree in faith and come together in prayer about something on Earth.

Then God gets permission to do so from heaven. So, the earth depends on the sky to get things done. But heaven depends on earth for permission to do so. So without you, God will not. This leads me to the third point. Prayer is in fact an earthly license for heavenly intervention. What is prayer? Think about what that means. Prayer is giving God a license to intervene in the affairs of the earth through the agency of faith in man. God cannot do what you do not believe He can do on Earth.

Christ says: According to your faith it will be done for you. Therefore, what happens here depends on what we believe God is capable of doing. Often when God met with humans, He would tell them what He wanted to do and then say this. Do you believe I can do this? The word “believes” is the Greek word “ Pistis”. It is the word that we translate as "faith". According to your faith, I can do it.

The Bibles mention that Jesus Christ once went to his hometown of Nazareth, but he could not perform any miracles there because the people did not believe in him. Can you imagine that all the power of the universe was in a body walking in your village and it cannot heal you because you do not believe? What a person does can either hinder or unleash God. Over the next three weeks, what I call a channel will become bigger and bigger, through which God will flow.

Something good will happen on Earth in the next three weeks. But if we don't agree, God cannot unleash what He wants to do on Earth. Therefore, we give him permission. This leads me to point four. Write this down. Prayer is not an option. It is a necessity. Necessity means that God is relying on you to ask Him to accomplish something He has always wanted to do on Earth.

That is why most of the time when you talk about prayer in the Bible, if you read a verse that relates to prayer, it begins with a two- letter word. "if". Most texts relating to prayer begin with the word " if" because it is a condition. There is a verse that religious people always quote when they want God to do something in their country. What is that verse? “If my people humble themselves,” look, it starts with “ if,” but they don’t read the whole verse correctly.

It's like turning away from their bad ways, nothing else, my dear. Look, they want God to heal the earth, but they don't want to deal with the other conditions. Did you see? Okay. There is always a condition. It is essential for us to pray so that God will do what He wants. That is why, when we talk about the keys to the kingdom, I want to read the words of Jesus himself, the King. Please write these words down. In Matthew 6:5, Christ placed this priority at the beginning of his ministry.

He said, "Whenever I pray," that is perfectly enough for me. Let everyone say together: "And when did you pray?" He did not say, "If you prayed." If I told you: Whenever you come, you can get something from my house. What should I say? I'm not even asking if you're coming. Hey you, you're coming. You are definitely coming. Look at his words. He didn't say if you find time in your busy schedule. He presupposes that you are aware of this. And when you pray, he expects it. Everyone knows that, but we don't do it.

Thus, we always refer prayer to a small group of people whom we call intercessors. The intercessor in the minds of religious churches is what I call a professional prayerful person. These are people we have appointed, so to speak. In fact, some of them appointed themselves. But we have this sort of group of people who do what we should be doing and don't. We use them as substitutes for ourselves. No one can do that. I can pray for you, but I can never replace you in prayer. Here's something to remember.

I was shocked when I discovered this. I was seventeen years old. I was fasting. The Lord told me this: There is nothing in the Bible called the ministry of intercession. She began to rebuke God. I said, "My mother is an intercessor." My mother used to pray all the time. God said, " Yes, but that is not a service." There is no gift of intercession in the Bible. Look for it. Not available. There is no gift of prayer in the Bible. There is a gift of tongues, and a gift of miracles, but there is no gift of prayer.

Do you know why? Because it's not a talent. Everyone is supposed to do it. But we love intercessors because they care about what we feel guilty about. We say to them: Pray for us. We're going to watch TV. So on the evening of the prayer meeting, everyone is at home drinking their drinks and watching television while a few elderly people pray. This is not God's will. Jesus said that people everywhere should always pray. "All people everywhere," he says, "not just a select few specialists."

Prayer is not a service for the few. It is a necessity for everyone. Now, don't misunderstand me, people should be praying for you. I thank God that people pray for me all the time. I have people who intercede for me. Oh my God, I thank God for that. But they should never, I should never think that they can replace my own prayers. I hope this fasting will change your attitude towards your life and prayer. Prayer is a necessity.

I want to put this here so you remember it because some of you have books about prayer in your home. Prayer books are similar to cookbooks. Recipe books. How many of you have cookbooks in your home? Let me see. All cookbooks. Let me see. You have cookbooks in your home. Come on, wave your hands high. Be honest. God is looking for who they are. Tell the truth. Good. Do you use them all? Do not lie. You don't use those cookbooks. You may occasionally want to know how to make a cookie or something like that.

Those books have been in your homes for ten years, and they contain wonderful recipes for preparing the most delicious foods, but you do not use them. In other words, having a recipe and baking a cake are two different things. Studying prayer and prayer itself are two different things. It's nice to have a good Vinnie book in your home. But do you pray? "Vinnie" was praying. Charles Finney was praying. Oswald Chambers wrote powerfully about prayer. He was praying.

Do not put this book on your table so that people see your beautiful prayer book and think you are spiritual. Prayer books were created for the purpose of prayer. You are learning how to pray. The book I wrote about prayer stems from my life. That's why people quote me. I write from my own experience. I write about what God has done for me, because it must be something that has worked for me before I can tell you that it is possible. Okay. Do not just study prayer. Pray. Don't just read about prayer. Pray.

Don't listen to other people's stories about prayer. Pray. That's what he expects from you. What is prayer? We will discuss this in more detail later, but I want to give you the definition before we go. The word prayer means supplication. The word petition means a legal appeal or request made to a government based on a constitutional right protected by law. It's complicated, but please write it down. Prayer is a plea.

A petition is a legal appeal or request that you make to a governmental authority, and this request is based on a constitutional right, and this right is protected by law. This is what prayer means. This is what the word means in the Bible. If you look at this statement, you will immediately realize that you cannot beg. Prayer is not begging for anything. Prayer is more like an appeal or a request based on legal rights. God does not want you loitering around His throne for the next three weeks, begging to no avail.

He wants to deal with you. He has things to do on earth, and now you are putting yourself in a state of dedication so that he can finally find a channel to pass them on. You will learn that fasting is interesting. Fasting. I remember when I started learning about fasting. I learned to fast from my mother and father. But my mother in particular, had some books in the house written by men such as Schambach, I. A. Allen, and Oral Roberts. I kept thinking, these men have a lot of spiritual power. I want that power.

They always said, "You have to pay the price." And I began to study that. Then I started doing it when I was a teenager. My life was turned upside down when I observed my first fast. Seven days. Then she wrote a song. The song is called "Living with Jesus on the Other Side". I wrote it while I was fasting. I began to understand that fasting is like a press. It was like a pipe cleaner for human life. I discovered that the food resembled rust in the pipe that was blocking the opening.

The more you eat, the smaller the opening of the pipe becomes until it is so blocked that God cannot deliver anything to you. Did you get the idea? And some of you are in this situation now. I have eaten so much in the past eight months that you yourself cannot pass anything. Am I right about that? You are so physically blocked that mentally you cannot even think clearly. Your mindset is affected. Your health has slowed down. She gets tired when climbing stairs. Imagine the spiritual clock.

Fasting is the only way to get rid of those things. Your body is both your greatest blessing and your greatest curse. It is a blessing because you need it to live on Earth. It's a curse because it can become your ruler. Fasting returns your body to where it belongs. Under your spirit. Fasting takes your body and subjects it to the spirit. Now, let's be honest. Sometimes you don't want to eat, that's true, from a spiritual perspective. You say to God, "I will fast today," but your body begins to overcome you.

In fact, this is the same day they decide to have a party at the office with chicken, pasta, peas and rice. Suddenly your body grabs your soul, crushes it, stands over it and says, "Today we shall eat." And all the saints say: " Amen". You are surrendering to your earthly body. Fasting stops that and restores it to order. Prayer is to ask God based on your rights as a citizen in the Kingdom of Heaven. We will discuss this in detail during this fast. How does this work.

You will see some sacred texts that you have never seen before in your life. I am going to present you with some ideas from the Bible that will change the way you have been taught throughout your life about prayer and fasting. Ladies and gentlemen, let's talk about the effects of fasting. I liked this. What happens when you fast? First and foremost, fasting changes you. Now, why did you say that? Because the number two is a contradiction. Fasting does not change God. God never changes.

There is nothing wrong with God. God is not blocked. The blockage should be on the other side. Fasting does not change God. He does not move God. It moves you and changes you. The best way to describe God and your fasting life is that before you fast or live a fasting life, it is like a large tank with 50,000 gallons of water and a small pipe connected to it. A small pipe with a diameter of two inches for this large tank. The amount of water available is 50,000 gallons.

But the amount that can flow through your small pipe is one-tenth of a gallon. The amount available does not change, but the amount that flows through the pipe depends on the size of the pipe. wow. And peace be upon you. The grains said, " Peace be upon you." Jesus, help me. With salted meat in it. Whoa! I can feel the tinge there.

This is your last round. You should enjoy it now. God is ready to act at any time. But it keeps bumping into these very small, blocked pipes, and they make a lot of noise. As you know, they shout, they claim, and they confess. God said, "But you are blocked." God is capable of doing anything. Yes. Yes. But I can't get anything other than this small hole you have. Number three, fasting increases your spiritual capacity. It's like going back to the tank, removing the two-inch pipe, and installing a 15-inch pipe. Now, more water can flow. God says, "Look, I need to find people who will increase their ability to cope with my flow." Let me tell you something, okay? Okay, I'm going to read the Bible. I will quote the Bible again. We love the Bible. Good? When there is crime in a country, economic chaos, social decay, and a lack of morals in a country, what do we do?

Let's call for a prayer meeting. We say, let all the bishops gather and we go to the garden and all the saints come with bellies full of grain. The bishop's belly is bigger than anyone else's. I want you to heal the nation, please. God said, " The things I need to heal your nation, that pipe will not do any good." So, what does God say about "my people" who claim to be called by my name, if they are what? Okay, write the word humility. The word "humility" in my book talked about this. The word humility means fasting. The translation into English was not a good translation. Humility means fasting and prayer. Do you want God to heal a big problem? He needs a large pipe.

They were all thinking, "We've been embarrassed in front of all these people." One of them took courage and Peter said, "Lord, why couldn't we cast out that demon yesterday?" Jesus said, “Well, this kind of thing doesn’t come out by prayer alone. This requires great power. If you’ve been trying to resolve something in your life for six months, maybe a year, maybe two years, and you’ve been working on something and it seems like it will never end, I’m going to give you the greatest secret.

Now, if you know that you have a right to it, if you know that it’s God’s will and His promise in His Word, if you know that it’s your rightful due from God, if you know that you deserve it, then you must break that thing. And you break it by fasting. This will be the best three weeks you’ve ever had. Every demon that has been holding you back will be removed by the power of God that flows through your fasting life. Are you ready to fast? Say yes. Fasting is the most powerful force in prayer. Habits.

My father comes here and sits in the front row and takes notes while I teach. My father is a Baptist minister. On one occasion he said to me, "My son, where did you get all this from?" He said, "You never learned this in our Baptist church." I said, "No, sir. I learned this while fasting." God can tell you things that He cannot tell you while you are chewing food. Your body starts working after you swallow it. It begins to react. They didn't tell me either. I had to learn this myself. Fasting calms the heart so that it can hear God. It calms distractions.

I promise you, ladies and gentlemen, that during the next three weeks you will feel more at peace in your minds than at any time in the past five years, because fasting calms your spirit, so the spirit becomes more important than the body and takes the lead. And your soul is not suffering from any problems. Did you know that? Only your mind is suffering. When your spirit becomes greater than your mind and body, your mind becomes subject to your spirit, and your spirit becomes filled with the peace of the Kingdom.
